project_id.description: The project ID associated with the Apigee organization.
project_id.rationale: It sets the project association and does not have any direct security impact.

display_name.description: The display name of the Apigee organization.
display_name.rationale: It sets the display name only and does not have any security impact.

description.rationale: It sets the description only and does not have any security impact.

analytics_region.description: Primary GCP region for analytics data storage.
analytics_region.rationale: Storing analytics data in unapproved regions may violate data residency and compliance requirements. Only approved regions should be used.

api_consumer_data_location.description: This field is needed only for customers using non-default data residency regions. Apigee stores some control plane data only in single region.
api_consumer_data_location.rationale: It sets the data residency location and does not have any direct security impact.

api_consumer_data_encryption_key_name.description: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting API consumer data.
api_consumer_data_encryption_key_name.rationale: Without a Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK), API consumer data is encrypted using Google-managed keys which may not satisfy compliance requirements. CMEK ensures full control over encryption keys.

control_plane_encryption_key_name.description: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting control plane data that is stored in a multi region. Only used for the data residency region US or EU.
control_plane_encryption_key_name.rationale: Without a Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK), control plane data is encrypted using Google-managed keys which may not satisfy compliance requirements. CMEK ensures full control over encryption keys for multi-region data.

authorized_network.description: Compute Engine network used for Service Networking to be peered with Apigee runtime instances.
authorized_network.rationale: It sets the network peering configuration and does not have any direct security impact.

disable_vpc_peering.description: Flag that specifies whether the VPC Peering through Private Google Access should be disabled between the consumer network and Apigee.
disable_vpc_peering.rationale: It sets the VPC peering configuration and does not have any direct security impact.

runtime_type.description: Runtime type of the Apigee organization based on the Apigee subscription purchased. Possible values are: CLOUD, HYBRID.
runtime_type.rationale: Setting runtime_type to HYBRID runs Apigee on customer-managed infrastructure which increases operational complexity and security risk. CLOUD uses Google-managed infrastructure with built-in security controls.

billing_type.description: Billing type of the Apigee organization.
billing_type.rationale: It sets the billing type only and does not have any security impact.

runtime_database_encryption_key_name.description: Cloud KMS key name used for encrypting the data that is stored and replicated across runtime instances. Update is not allowed after the organization is created.
runtime_database_encryption_key_name.rationale: Without a Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK), runtime database data is encrypted using Google-managed keys which may not satisfy compliance requirements. CMEK ensures full control over encryption of data replicated across runtime instances.

retention.description: Controls how long Organization data will be retained after the initial delete operation completes. Possible values are: DELETION_RETENTION_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMUM.
retention.rationale: Setting retention to DELETION_RETENTION_UNSPECIFIED does not guarantee minimum data retention after deletion, preventing recovery of accidentally deleted organizations. MINIMUM ensures data is retained for the minimum period.

properties.description: Properties defined in the Apigee organization profile.
properties.rationale: It sets custom key-value properties and does not have any direct security impact.

property.description: List of all properties in the object.
property.rationale: It sets custom properties and does not have any security impact.

name.rationale: It sets the property key name and does not have any security impact.

value.rationale: It sets the property value and does not have any security impact.
